entry.digest: Change and/or listen for changes in interface colors
entry.description: Output the interface color whenever it changes, query Max for current color settings, and change an interface color.

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Set the current color, or output a color
messages.description: The message, followed by a valid interface color, will change the current color that theobject is watching.A message containing a valid interface color will output the values of that color from the leftmost outlet.A message containing a valid interface color, followed by four RGBA color values, will change the select interface color to the new values.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Outputs the currently selected interface color from the leftmost outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: A list of four colors (RGBA) will change the value of the current interface color.

inlets.digest: list Sets Color, bang Reports Color
